evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 6.5→12.3→16.2→19.5→25.7 ppm, instead of staying at purge-floor ~5 ppm
Ar flow steady at setpoint 100 sccm, so rise is not a purge-gas loss
Temperature holds 750 °C with plausible heater power; thermal control nominal
Pressure gauge not installed, so leak cannot be confirmed by pressure; atmosphere verification is incomplete for this stage

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) or a flow-step/pressure-hold leak test to confirm air ingress; continued O2 trend to see if it keeps climbing
